title: A mine: cross-sections of the galleries with miners digging. Etching by R. Bénard after L.J. Goussier.
depicts: Engraved plate (Pl. III). Top strip: surface landscape with mountains, a cut-away timber winding house with a large vertical drum, probably a horse gin (Fig. 1), a shed and a wooden launder/bridge (Fig. 2). Below: a cut-away of the ground showing a deep vertical shaft lined with timber cribbing, ladders, and side galleries; small figures of miners hacking at the rock with picks on stepped working faces at the bottom (letters P-V) and one miner in a gallery at left (X); inset vignettes of timbering methods (a-m). Lettering 'Minéralogie, Coupe d'une Mine', 'Goussier Del.', 'Benard Fecit'. Good 'how deep mines are' shot; no water pumping shown explicitly.
